final: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM observatories AS o JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_counts AS (SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM station_averages GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT p.lunarstage, AVG(s.avg_usage), p.station_count, CAST(p.station_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station_averages) FROM phase_counts AS p JOIN station_averages AS s ON s.lunarstage IS p.lunarstage GROUP BY p.lunarstage, p.station_count
